education_date_range_check.name: education_date_range_check
education_date_range_check.value: "education"."end_date" is null or "education"."start_date" is null or "education"."end_date" >= "education"."start_date"

experience_date_range_check.name: experience_date_range_check
experience_date_range_check.value: "experience"."end_date" is null or "experience"."start_date" is null or "experience"."end_date" >= "experience"."start_date"

media_dimensions_check.name: media_dimensions_check
media_dimensions_check.value: ("media"."width" is null and "media"."height" is null) or ("media"."width" > 0 and "media"."height" > 0)

navigation_items_destination_check.name: navigation_items_destination_check
navigation_items_destination_check.value:
(
        ("navigation_items"."type" = 'page' and "navigation_items"."page_id" is not null and "navigation_items"."url" is null)
        or ("navigation_items"."type" = 'external' and "navigation_items"."page_id" is null and "navigation_items"."url" is not null)
        or ("navigation_items"."type" in ('posts', 'projects', 'publications', 'cv') and "navigation_items"."page_id" is null and "navigation_items"."url" is null)
      )

projects_date_range_check.name: projects_date_range_check
projects_date_range_check.value: "projects"."ended_on" is null or "projects"."started_on" is null or "projects"."ended_on" >= "projects"."started_on"
